decisions.reason: This two-component resin injection unit is very close to the firm's established plural-component and injection know-how, so its engineering and service base give it strong capacity to learn from early use and improve it.

Because this resin injection unit builds directly on the firm's existing fluid-handling and injection capabilities, management would likely retain it and exploit customer feedback rather than exit quickly.
An automatic airless spray gun fits the firm's core spray-application competence, making it a product the firm can readily refine through accumulated design knowledge and application experience.

A manual airless spray gun is tightly related to the firm's long-standing gun and coating equipment business, so the firm has the absorptive capacity to interpret market feedback and keep developing it.
This air-assisted airless spray gun remains within the firm's central technological domain, where its manufacturing experience and distributor network support continued commercial improvement.

The data logger is less aligned with the firm's traditional mechanical equipment knowledge base, and its fall from a dedicated page to only a mention signals weak traction and limited ability to improve it from existing capabilities.
